verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity emits events and webhooks so a developer's own integration can react to verification outcomes. That is a developer building block, not a product-native rules engine where users define event-triggered automations. The document blocklist is a related but narrower control, a single fixed block action rather than user-defined rules, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Listen for verification results so your integration can automatically trigger reactions.
Stripe generates events every time a session changes status.
Add the document to a blocklist to programmatically block future verifications completed with the same document.
